```{r funcio_DEG_volcano}
# Funció generalitzada: accepta qualsevol variable de grup i qualsevol subset de dades.
#
# Paràmetres:
#   data              — data frame amb Codi_Noray, columnes Endogenous_* i la variable de grup
#   subset_label      — string curt per als noms de fitxer (sense espais)
#   subset_description— string llegible per als títols del plot
#   group_var         — nom de la columna de grup (string), p.ex. "clinical_benefit" o "pSTAT3_group"
#   group_levels      — vector c("nivell_ref", "nivell_comparador") tal com apareixen a la columna
#   group_labels      — vector c("label_ref", "label_comparador") per als plots i contrastos
#   output_dir        — directori de sortida
#   xlim_v, ylim_v    — límits dels eixos del volcano

run_deg_volcano <- function(data,
                            subset_label,
                            subset_description,
                            group_var,
                            group_levels,
                            group_labels,
                            output_dir,
                            xlim_v = c(-4, 4),
                            ylim_v = c(0, 4)) {

  # --- Expression matrix ---
  expr_mat <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(Codi_Noray, starts_with("Endogenous_")) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    column_to_rownames("Codi_Noray") %>%
    t() %>%
    as.matrix()

  # --- Metadata ---
  meta <- data %>%
    dplyr::select(Codi_Noray, all_of(group_var)) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(.data[[group_var]],
                          levels = group_levels,
                          labels = group_labels)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
    column_to_rownames("Codi_Noray")

  common_samples <- intersect(colnames(expr_mat), rownames(meta))
  expr_mat <- expr_mat[, common_samples]
  meta     <- meta[common_samples, , drop = FALSE]

  n_table <- table(meta$group)
  n_ref   <- as.integer(n_table[group_labels[1]])
  n_comp  <- as.integer(n_table[group_labels[2]])
  n_total <- ncol(expr_mat)

  cat("\n===== Subset:", subset_label, "=====\n")
  cat("N total:", n_total,
      "|", group_labels[2], ":", n_comp,
      "|", group_labels[1], ":", n_ref, "\n")

  if (any(n_table < 2)) {
    warning("Subset '", subset_label, "' té un grup amb <2 pacients. Saltant anàlisi.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # --- Design + contrast + fit ---
  safe_labels <- make.names(group_labels)
  meta <- meta %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = group_labels, labels = safe_labels))

  design <- model.matrix(~0 + group, data = meta)
  colnames(design) <- safe_labels

  contrast_name <- paste0(safe_labels[2], "_vs_", safe_labels[1])
  contrast <- makeContrasts(
    contrasts = setNames(
      paste0(safe_labels[2], " - ", safe_labels[1]),
      contrast_name
    ),
    levels = design
  )

  fit <- lmFit(expr_mat, design) %>%
    contrasts.fit(contrast) %>%
    eBayes()

  # --- Resultats ---
  deg <- topTable(fit, number = Inf, adjust.method = "none", sort.by = "none") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    mutate(
      gene_clean = gene %>%
        str_extract("(?<=Endogenous_).*") %>%
        str_remove("_[NX][MR]_\\d+\\.?\\d*$"),
      direction = ifelse(logFC > 0,
                         paste0("Up in ", group_labels[2]),
                         paste0("Up in ", group_labels[1]))
    ) %>%
    arrange(P.Value)

  write_csv(deg, file.path(output_dir,
            paste0("DEG_results_", subset_label, ".csv")))

  # --- Títols ---
  genes_up_n   <- sum(deg$logFC >  1 & deg$P.Value < 0.05)
  genes_down_n <- sum(deg$logFC < -1 & deg$P.Value < 0.05)

  plot_title <- paste0("Subset: ", subset_description, "  |  N = ", n_total)
  plot_subtitle <- paste0(
    group_labels[2], " (n = ", n_comp, ")",
    "  vs  ",
    group_labels[1], " (n = ", n_ref, ")",
    "\n[Up in ", group_labels[2], ": ", genes_up_n,
    "  |  Down in ", group_labels[2], ": ", genes_down_n, "]"
  )

  # --- Etiquetes: NOMÉS gens DEG (p < 0.05 I |FC| > 1) ---
  deg_rows      <- which(deg$P.Value < 0.05 & abs(deg$logFC) > 1 & !is.na(deg$gene_clean))
  select_labels <- rep("", nrow(deg))
  select_labels[deg_rows] <- deg$gene_clean[deg_rows]

  cat("Gens DEG etiquetats:", select_labels[select_labels != ""], "\n")

  # --- Volcano ---
  v <- EnhancedVolcano(
    deg,
    lab             = select_labels,
    selectLab       = select_labels[select_labels != ""],
    x               = "logFC",
    y               = "P.Value",
    pCutoff         = 0.05,
    FCcutoff        = 1,
    title           = plot_title,
    subtitle        = plot_subtitle,
    col             = c("grey60",    # NS
                        "grey60",    # només FC
                        "steelblue", # només p < 0.05
                        "red2"),     # p < 0.05 + FC > 1
    colAlpha        = 0.7,
    legendLabels    = c("Not significant", "Log2FC > 1", "P < 0.05",
                        "P < 0.05 & Log2FC > 1"),
    xlim            = xlim_v,
    ylim            = ylim_v,
    drawConnectors  = TRUE,
    widthConnectors = 0.5,
    max.overlaps    = Inf
  )

  print(v)
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, paste0("Volcano_", subset_label, ".png")),
         plot = v, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)

  return(deg)
}
```

```{r volcano_cohort_completa}
deg_results <- run_deg_volcano(
  data               = db_completa_log2,
  subset_label       = "Benefit_vs_NoBenefit",
  subset_description = "All patients",
  group_var          = "clinical_benefit",
  group_levels       = c(0, 1),
  group_labels       = c("No_Benefit", "Benefit"),
  output_dir         = output_dir
)
```

```{r heatmap_7_DEGs}
sig_genes      <- deg_results %>% filter(P.Value < 0.05) %>% pull(gene)
heatmap_matrix <- expression_matrix[sig_genes, ]
rownames(heatmap_matrix) <- str_extract(rownames(heatmap_matrix), "(?<=Endogenous_)[^_]+")
heatmap_scaled <- t(scale(t(heatmap_matrix)))

match_idx <- match(colnames(heatmap_matrix), db_completa_log2$Codi_Noray)

pSTAT3_cat <- cut(
  db_completa_log2$pSTAT3_Histoscore[match_idx],
  breaks = c(-Inf, 29, 73, Inf),
  labels = c("low", "intermediate", "high"),
  right  = TRUE
)

annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Clinical_Benefit  = factor(db_completa_log2$clinical_benefit[match_idx],
                             levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Benefit", "No_Benefit")),
  PDL1              = factor(db_completa_log2$PDL1[match_idx],
                             levels = c(1, 0, 2), labels = c("Positive", "Negative", "Unknown")),
  CavOral           = factor(db_completa_log2$CavOral_si_no[match_idx],
                             levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Yes", "No")),
  pSTAT3_Histoscore = pSTAT3_cat
)
rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(heatmap_matrix)

ann_colors <- list(
  Clinical_Benefit  = c("Benefit" = "#9A32CD",    "No_Benefit"   = "#00CED1"),
  PDL1              = c("Positive" = "orange",     "Negative"     = "steelblue", "Unknown" = "grey"),
  CavOral           = c("Yes" = "khaki",           "No"           = "olivedrab"),
  pSTAT3_Histoscore = c("low" = "plum",            "intermediate" = "rosybrown", "high"    = "maroon")
)

heatmap_args <- list(
  mat               = heatmap_scaled,
  annotation_col    = annotation_col,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  cluster_rows      = TRUE,
  cluster_cols      = TRUE,
  show_colnames     = FALSE,
  fontsize_row      = 11,
  fontsize          = 10,
  border_color      = NA,
  main              = "Differentially Expressed Genes (P < 0.05)",
  angle_col         = 45
)

do.call(pheatmap, heatmap_args)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "Heatmap_7DEGs.png"),
  plot     = do.call(pheatmap, heatmap_args),
  width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300
)
```

# ── Nous volcanos: anàlisi per pSTAT3 ─────────────────────────────────────────

```{r preparar_pSTAT3_subsets}
# Categoritzem pSTAT3 en un sol lloc per reutilitzar-ho als 3 chunks següents.
# Breaks: low ≤ 29 < intermediate ≤ 73 < high  (mateixos que al heatmap)
db_pstat3 <- db_completa_log2 %>%
  mutate(
    pSTAT3_group = cut(
      haven::zap_labels(pSTAT3_Histoscore),
      breaks = c(-Inf, 29, 73, Inf),
      labels = c("low", "intermediate", "high"),
      right  = TRUE
    )
  )

cat("Distribució pSTAT3_group:\n")
print(table(db_pstat3$pSTAT3_group, useNA = "ifany"))

# Subsets low i high (exclou intermediate per als comparadors 2 i 3)
db_pstat3_low  <- db_pstat3 %>% filter(pSTAT3_group == "low")
db_pstat3_high <- db_pstat3 %>% filter(pSTAT3_group == "high")
```

```{r volcano_pSTAT3_low_vs_high}
# Comparació 1: tots els pacients, pSTAT3 low vs high
# (s'exclouen automàticament els intermediate perquè no estan en group_levels)
deg_pstat3_lowVShigh <- run_deg_volcano(
  data               = db_pstat3,
  subset_label       = "pSTAT3_High_vs_Low",
  subset_description = "All patients",
  group_var          = "pSTAT3_group",
  group_levels       = c("low", "high"),   # ref = low, comparador = high
  group_labels       = c("pSTAT3_Low", "pSTAT3_High"),
  output_dir         = output_dir
)
```

# ── Nous volcanos: anàlisi per resposta RECIST ────────────────────────────────

```{r preparar_RECIST_subsets}
# Codificació: 0=RC, 1=RP, 2=EE, 3=PE, 4=NA
# Comparació 1: RC vs PE
# Comparació 2: Control malaltia (RC+RP+EE) vs PE

db_recist <- db_completa_log2 %>%
  mutate(
    Mejor_respuesta_a_IT = haven::zap_labels(Mejor_respuesta_a_IT),
    
    # Grup per RC vs PE
    recist_RC_vs_PE = case_when(
      Mejor_respuesta_a_IT == 0 ~ "RC",
      Mejor_respuesta_a_IT == 3 ~ "PE",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    # Grup per control malaltia vs PE
    recist_DCR_vs_PE = case_when(
      Mejor_respuesta_a_IT %in% c(0, 1, 2) ~ "DCR",
      Mejor_respuesta_a_IT == 3             ~ "PE",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

cat("Distribució Mejor_respuesta_a_IT (original):\n")
print(table(db_recist$Mejor_respuesta_a_IT, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\nRC vs PE:\n")
print(table(db_recist$recist_RC_vs_PE, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\nDCR vs PE:\n")
print(table(db_recist$recist_DCR_vs_PE, useNA = "ifany"))
```

```{r volcano_pSTAT3_low_vs_high_no_cavOral}
deg_pstat3_lowVShigh_no_oc <- run_deg_volcano(
  data               = db_pstat3_no_oc,
  subset_label       = "pSTAT3_High_vs_Low_No_OralCavity",
```

```{r preparar_responders_subsets}
# Codificació: 0=RC, 1=RP, 2=EE, 3=PE, 4=NA

      Mejor_respuesta_a_IT %in% c(0, 1) ~ "Responder",
      Mejor_respuesta_a_IT %in% c(2, 3) ~ "Non_Responder",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

# ------ BOXPLOTS -------
```{r boxplots_responders_6gens}
library(cowplot)

genes_of_interest <- c("WNT10A", "IL24", "PRKX", "TWIST2", "STAT3", "CD274")

db_boxplot <- db_responders %>%
  mutate(
    responder_group = factor(responder_group,
                             levels = c("Non_Responder", "Responder"),
                             labels = c("Non-Responder", "Responder"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(responder_group)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Codi_Noray, responder_group, starts_with("Endogenous_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("Endogenous_"),
    names_to  = "gene_raw",
    values_to = "expression"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gene_clean      = gene_raw %>%
      str_extract("(?<=Endogenous_).*") %>%
      str_remove("_[NX][MR]_\\d+\\.?\\d*$"),
    # Re-factoritzar explícitament després del pivot
    responder_group = factor(responder_group,
                             levels = c("Non-Responder", "Responder"))
  ) %>%
  filter(gene_clean %in% genes_of_interest)

group_colors <- c("Non-Responder" = "maroon",
                  "Responder"     = "cornflowerblue")

group_labels_display <- c("Non-Responder" = "Non-Responder\n(SD+PD)",
                          "Responder"     = "Responder\n(CR+PR)")

plot_boxplot_gene <- function(gene_name, data, colors, labels_display, output_dir) {
  
  df <- data %>%
    filter(gene_clean == gene_name) %>%
    mutate(responder_group = factor(responder_group,
                                    levels = c("Non-Responder", "Responder")))
  
  wt      <- wilcox.test(expression ~ responder_group, data = df, exact = FALSE)
  p_label <- ifelse(wt$p.value < 0.05,
                    paste0("p = ", formatC(wt$p.value, format = "f", digits = 3), " *"),
                    paste0("p = ", formatC(wt$p.value, format = "f", digits = 3)))
  
  y_max   <- max(df$expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min   <- min(df$expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  y_annot <- y_max + y_range * 0.12
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = responder_group, y = expression, fill = responder_group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75, width = 0.45,
                 color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = responder_group), width = 0.12, size = 2.2,
                alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE) +
    annotate("segment",
             x = 1, xend = 2,
             y = y_annot, yend = y_annot,
             color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
    annotate("text",
             x = 1.5, y = y_annot + y_range * 0.05,
             label = p_label, size = 3.8, color = "grey20") +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels  = labels_display) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min - y_range * 0.05,
                             y_annot + y_range * 0.15)) +
    labs(title = gene_name, x = NULL, y = "log2 Expression") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey20"),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 10)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("Boxplot_Responders_", gene_name, ".png")),
    plot     = p, width = 3.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(p)
}

plots_list <- lapply(genes_of_interest, plot_boxplot_gene,
                     data           = db_boxplot,
                     colors         = group_colors,
                     labels_display = group_labels_display,
                     output_dir     = output_dir)
names(plots_list) <- genes_of_interest

panel <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots_list, ncol = 3, nrow = 2, align = "hv")

panel_title <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
  cowplot::draw_label("Responder (CR+PR) vs Non-Responder (SD+PD)",
                      fontface = "bold", size = 13, x = 0.5, hjust = 0.5)

panel_final <- cowplot::plot_grid(panel_title, panel,
                                  ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.06, 1))
print(panel_final)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "Boxplots_Responders_6genes_panel.png"),
  plot     = panel_final, width = 11, height = 9, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r boxplots_PDvsResponders_6gens}
library(cowplot)

genes_of_interest <- c("WNT10A", "IL24", "PRKX", "TWIST2", "STAT3", "CD274")

db_boxplot_PD <- db_responders %>%
  filter(Mejor_respuesta_a_IT %in% c(0, 1, 3)) %>%
  mutate(
    pd_group = case_when(
      Mejor_respuesta_a_IT == 3          ~ "PD",
      Mejor_respuesta_a_IT %in% c(0, 1) ~ "Responder"
    ),
    pd_group = factor(pd_group, levels = c("PD", "Responder"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Codi_Noray, pd_group, starts_with("Endogenous_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("Endogenous_"),
    names_to  = "gene_raw",
    values_to = "expression"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gene_clean = gene_raw %>%
      str_extract("(?<=Endogenous_).*") %>%
      str_remove("_[NX][MR]_\\d+\\.?\\d*$"),
    pd_group   = factor(pd_group, levels = c("PD", "Responder"))
  ) %>%
  filter(gene_clean %in% genes_of_interest)

group_colors_PD <- c("PD"        = "maroon",
                     "Responder" = "cornflowerblue")

group_labels_PD <- c("PD"        = "Non-Responder\n(PD)",
                     "Responder" = "Responder\n(CR+PR)")

plot_boxplot_gene_PD <- function(gene_name, data, colors, labels_display, output_dir) {
  
  df <- data %>%
    filter(gene_clean == gene_name) %>%
    mutate(pd_group = droplevels(factor(pd_group, levels = c("PD", "Responder"))))
  
  wt      <- wilcox.test(expression ~ pd_group, data = df, exact = FALSE)
  p_label <- ifelse(wt$p.value < 0.05,
                    paste0("p = ", formatC(wt$p.value, format = "f", digits = 3), " *"),
                    paste0("p = ", formatC(wt$p.value, format = "f", digits = 3)))
  
  y_max   <- max(df$expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min   <- min(df$expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  y_annot <- y_max + y_range * 0.12
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = pd_group, y = expression, fill = pd_group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75, width = 0.45,
                 color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = pd_group), width = 0.12, size = 2.2,
                alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE) +
    annotate("segment",
             x = 1, xend = 2,
             y = y_annot, yend = y_annot,
             color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
    annotate("text",
             x = 1.5, y = y_annot + y_range * 0.05,
             label = p_label, size = 3.8, color = "grey20") +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels  = labels_display) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min - y_range * 0.05,
                             y_annot + y_range * 0.15)) +
    labs(title = gene_name, x = NULL, y = "log2 Expression") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey20"),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 10)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("Boxplot_PD_vs_CRPR_", gene_name, ".png")),
    plot     = p, width = 3.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(p)
}

plots_list_PD <- lapply(genes_of_interest, plot_boxplot_gene_PD,
                        data           = db_boxplot_PD,
                        colors         = group_colors_PD,
                        labels_display = group_labels_PD,
                        output_dir     = output_dir)
names(plots_list_PD) <- genes_of_interest

panel_PD <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots_list_PD, ncol = 3, nrow = 2, align = "hv")

panel_title_PD <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
  cowplot::draw_label("Responder (CR+PR) vs Non-Responder (PD only)",
                      fontface = "bold", size = 13, x = 0.5, hjust = 0.5)

panel_final_PD <- cowplot::plot_grid(panel_title_PD, panel_PD,
                                     ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.06, 1))
print(panel_final_PD)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "Boxplots_PD_vs_CRPR_6genes_panel.png"),
  plot     = panel_final_PD, width = 11, height = 9, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r boxplots_CRvsPD_6gens}
}

plots_list_PD <- lapply(genes_of_interest, plot_boxplot_gene_PD,
```

```{r boxplots_4groups_6gens}
library(cowplot)

genes_of_interest <- c("WNT10A", "IL24", "PRKX", "TWIST2", "STAT3", "CD274")

response_levels <- c("CR", "PR", "SD", "PD")

group_colors <- c(
  "CR" = "hotpink2",
  "PR" = "gold1",
  "SD" = "blue",
  "PD" = "steelblue3"
)

group_labels_display <- c(
  "CR" = "CR\n(Complete\nResponse)",
  "PR" = "PR\n(Partial\nResponse)",
  "SD" = "SD\n(Stable\nDisease)",
  "PD" = "PD\n(Progressive\nDisease)"
)

db_boxplot <- db_completa_log2 %>%
  mutate(
    response_group = factor(
      recode(as.character(zap_labels(Mejor_respuesta_a_IT)),
             "0" = "CR",
             "1" = "PR",
             "2" = "SD",
             "3" = "PD"),
      levels = response_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(response_group)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Codi_Noray, response_group, starts_with("Endogenous_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("Endogenous_"),
    names_to  = "gene_raw",
    values_to = "expression"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gene_clean = gene_raw %>%
      str_extract("(?<=Endogenous_).*") %>%
      str_remove("_[NX][MR]_\\d+\\.?\\d*$")
  ) %>%
  filter(gene_clean %in% genes_of_interest)

plot_boxplot_gene_4grp <- function(gene_name, data, colors, labels_display, output_dir) {
  
  df <- data %>%
    filter(gene_clean == gene_name) %>%
    mutate(response_group = factor(response_group, levels = names(colors)))
  
  # Guarda: mínim 2 grups amb dades
  n_groups <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(response_group)) %>%
    pull(response_group) %>%
    droplevels() %>%
    nlevels()
  
  if (n_groups < 2) {
    message("Skipping ", gene_name, ": fewer than 2 groups with data")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Kruskal-Wallis global
  kw       <- kruskal.test(expression ~ response_group, data = df)
  kw_label <- ifelse(
    kw$p.value < 0.05,
    paste0("Kruskal-Wallis p = ", formatC(kw$p.value, format = "f", digits = 3), " *"),
    paste0("Kruskal-Wallis p = ", formatC(kw$p.value, format = "f", digits = 3))
  )
  
  y_max   <- max(df$expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min   <- min(df$expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  y_annot <- y_max + y_range * 0.10
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = response_group, y = expression, fill = response_group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75, width = 0.5,
                 color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = response_group), width = 0.12, size = 2.0,
                alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE) +
    annotate("text",
             x = 2.5, y = y_annot + y_range * 0.05,
             label = kw_label, size = 3.2, color = "grey20") +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels  = labels_display) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min - y_range * 0.05,
                             y_annot + y_range * 0.20)) +
    labs(title = gene_name, x = NULL, y = "log2 Expression") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey20"),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 10)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("Boxplot_4groups_", gene_name, ".png")),
    plot     = p, width = 4.0, height = 4.5, dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(p)
}

plots_list <- lapply(genes_of_interest, plot_boxplot_gene_4grp,
                     data           = db_boxplot,
                     colors         = group_colors,
                     labels_display = group_labels_display,
                     output_dir     = output_dir)
names(plots_list) <- genes_of_interest

# Elimina nulls per si algun gen ha fallat la guarda
plots_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), plots_list)

panel <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots_list, ncol = 3, nrow = 2, align = "hv")

panel_title <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
  cowplot::draw_label("Gene Expression by RECIST Response Category",
                      fontface = "bold", size = 13, x = 0.5, hjust = 0.5)

panel_final <- cowplot::plot_grid(panel_title, panel,
                                  ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.05, 1))
print(panel_final)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "Boxplots_4groups_6genes_panel.png"),
  plot     = panel_final, width = 13, height = 9, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r PDL1_MAGEA4_boxpltos}
# ============================================================
# BOXPLOTS: PD-L1 expression (Benefit vs No Benefit)
#           MAGEA4 expression (4 comparisons)
# ============================================================

library(cowplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(haven)

# ── 0. Funció genèrica de boxplot 2 grups ────────────────────

plot_boxplot_2grp <- function(gene_name, data_long,
                               grp_var, grp_levels, grp_labels,
                               grp_colors, subtitle = NULL,
                               output_dir) {

  df <- data_long %>%
    filter(gene_clean == gene_name) %>%
    mutate(grp = factor(.data[[grp_var]], levels = grp_levels))

  n_groups <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(grp)) %>%
    pull(grp) %>%
    droplevels() %>%
    nlevels()

  if (n_groups < 2) {
    message("Skipping ", gene_name, " [", grp_var, "]: fewer than 2 groups")
    return(NULL)
  }

  wt        <- wilcox.test(expression ~ grp, data = df, exact = FALSE)
  wt_label  <- ifelse(
    wt$p.value < 0.05,
    paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", formatC(wt$p.value, format = "f", digits = 3), " *"),
    paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", formatC(wt$p.value, format = "f", digits = 3))
  )

  y_max   <- max(df$expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min   <- min(df$expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  y_annot <- y_max + y_range * 0.10

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = grp, y = expression, fill = grp)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75, width = 0.45,
                 color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = grp), width = 0.10, size = 2.2,
                alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE) +
    annotate("text",
             x = 1.5, y = y_annot + y_range * 0.05,
             label = wt_label, size = 3.2, color = "grey20") +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = grp_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = grp_colors) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels  = grp_labels) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min - y_range * 0.05,
                             y_annot + y_range * 0.22)) +
    labs(
      title    = gene_name,
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x        = NULL,
      y        = "log2 Expression"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, color = "grey40"),
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey20"),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  fname <- paste0("Boxplot_", gene_name, "_", grp_var, ".png")
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, fname),
    plot     = p, width = 3.8, height = 4.5, dpi = 300
  )

  return(p)
}

# ── 1. Preparació: taula llarga amb PD-L1 i MAGEA4 ──────────

genes_target <- c("CD274", "MAGEA4")   # CD274 = PD-L1

db_long <- db_completa_log2 %>%
  mutate(
    # Clinical benefit: 0 = CR/PR/SD → Benefit, 1 = PD → No Benefit
    # Canvia NOMÉS aquest bloc dins del mutate() de db_long:

benefit = factor(
  case_when(
    zap_labels(clinical_benefit) == 1 ~ "Benefit",
    zap_labels(clinical_benefit) == 0 ~ "No Benefit",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ),
  levels = c("Benefit", "No Benefit")
),
    # Responders (CR/PR) vs Non-Responders (SD/PD)
    responder = factor(
      case_when(
        zap_labels(Mejor_respuesta_a_IT) %in% c(0, 1) ~ "Responder",
        zap_labels(Mejor_respuesta_a_IT) %in% c(2, 3) ~ "Non-Responder",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = c("Responder", "Non-Responder")
    ),
    # Disease Control (CR/PR/SD) vs Progressive Evaluation (PD)
    dcr_pe = factor(
      case_when(
        zap_labels(Mejor_respuesta_a_IT) %in% c(0, 1, 2) ~ "DCR",
        zap_labels(Mejor_respuesta_a_IT) == 3              ~ "PE",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = c("DCR", "PE")
    ),
    # CR vs PD (excloem SD i PR)
    cr_vs_pd = factor(
      case_when(
        zap_labels(Mejor_respuesta_a_IT) == 0 ~ "CR",
        zap_labels(Mejor_respuesta_a_IT) == 3 ~ "PD",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = c("CR", "PD")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Codi_Noray,
                benefit, responder, dcr_pe, cr_vs_pd,
                starts_with("Endogenous_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("Endogenous_"),
    names_to  = "gene_raw",
    values_to = "expression"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gene_clean = gene_raw %>%
      str_extract("(?<=Endogenous_).*") %>%
      str_remove("_[NX][MR]_\\d+\\.?\\d*$")
  ) %>%
  filter(gene_clean %in% genes_target)

# ── 2. PD-L1 (CD274): Benefit vs No Benefit ─────────────────

p_pdl1_benefit <- plot_boxplot_2grp(
  gene_name  = "CD274",
  data_long  = db_long,
  grp_var    = "benefit",
  grp_levels = c("Benefit", "No Benefit"),
  grp_labels = c("Benefit\n(CR/PR/SD)", "No Benefit\n(PD)"),
  grp_colors = annotation_colors_full$Clinical_Benefit,
  subtitle   = "PD-L1 (CD274)",
  output_dir = output_dir
)

# ── 3. MAGEA4: 4 comparacions ────────────────────────────────

comparisons_magea4 <- list(
  list(
    grp_var    = "benefit",
    grp_levels = c("Benefit", "No Benefit"),
    grp_labels = c("Benefit", "No Benefit"),
    grp_colors = annotation_colors_full$Clinical_Benefit,
    subtitle   = "Benefit vs No Benefit"
  ),
  list(
    grp_var    = "responder",
    grp_levels = c("Responder", "Non-Responder"),
    grp_labels = c("Responder\n(CR/PR)", "Non-Responder\n(SD/PD)"),
    grp_colors = c("Responder"     = annotation_colors_full$Resposta_Terapeutica[["Responder"]],
                   "Non-Responder" = annotation_colors_full$Resposta_Terapeutica[["No Responder"]]),
    subtitle   = "Responders vs Non-Responders"
  ),
  list(
    grp_var    = "dcr_pe",
    grp_levels = c("DCR", "PE"),
    grp_labels = c("DCR\n(CR/PR/SD)", "PE\n(PD)"),
    grp_colors = c("DCR" = annotation_colors_full$Resposta_Clinica[["EE"]],   # blau
                   "PE"  = annotation_colors_full$Resposta_Clinica[["PE"]]),   # steelblue3
    subtitle   = "Disease Control vs Progressive Evaluation"
  ),
  list(
    grp_var    = "cr_vs_pd",
    grp_levels = c("CR", "PD"),
    grp_labels = c("CR\n(Complete\nResponse)", "PD\n(Progressive\nDisease)"),
    grp_colors = c("CR" = annotation_colors_full$Resposta_Clinica[["RC"]],
                   "PD" = annotation_colors_full$Resposta_Clinica[["PE"]]),
    subtitle   = "CR vs PD"
  )
)

plots_magea4 <- lapply(comparisons_magea4, function(comp) {
  plot_boxplot_2grp(
    gene_name  = "MAGEA4",
    data_long  = db_long,
    grp_var    = comp$grp_var,
    grp_levels = comp$grp_levels,
    grp_labels = comp$grp_labels,
    grp_colors = comp$grp_colors,
    subtitle   = comp$subtitle,
    output_dir = output_dir
  )
})
names(plots_magea4) <- sapply(comparisons_magea4, `[[`, "grp_var")
plots_magea4 <- Filter(Negate(is.null), plots_magea4)

# ── 4. Panels ────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Panel PD-L1 (un sol plot, no cal grid)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "Boxplot_PDL1_benefit.png"),
  plot     = p_pdl1_benefit,
  width = 3.8, height = 4.5, dpi = 300
)

# Panel MAGEA4 (2×2)
panel_magea4 <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  plotlist = plots_magea4,
  ncol = 2, nrow = 2, align = "hv"
)

panel_title_magea4 <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
  cowplot::draw_label(
    "MAGEA4 Expression across Response Categories",
    fontface = "bold", size = 13, x = 0.5, hjust = 0.5
  )

panel_final_magea4 <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  panel_title_magea4, panel_magea4,
  ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.05, 1)
)

print(p_pdl1_benefit)
print(panel_final_magea4)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "Boxplots_MAGEA4_4comparisons_panel.png"),
  plot     = panel_final_magea4,
  width = 9, height = 9, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r boxplots_clinicalBenefit}
library(cowplot)
genes_of_interest <- c("WNT10A", "IL24", "PRKX", "TWIST2")
db_boxplot_CB <- db_completa_log2 %>%
  mutate(
    cb_group = case_when(
      clinical_benefit == 1 ~ "Clinical benefit",
      clinical_benefit == 0 ~ "No clinical benefit"
    ),
    cb_group = factor(cb_group, levels = c("No clinical benefit", "Clinical benefit"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cb_group)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Codi_Noray, cb_group, starts_with("Endogenous_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("Endogenous_"),
    names_to  = "gene_raw",
    values_to = "expression"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gene_clean = gene_raw %>%
      str_extract("(?<=Endogenous_).*") %>%
      str_remove("_[NX][MR]_\\d+\\.?\\d*$"),
    cb_group   = factor(cb_group, levels = c("No clinical benefit", "Clinical benefit"))
  ) %>%
  filter(gene_clean %in% genes_of_interest)
group_colors_CB <- c("No clinical benefit" = "maroon",
                     "Clinical benefit"    = "cornflowerblue")
group_labels_CB <- c("No clinical benefit" = "No clinical benefit",
                     "Clinical benefit"    = "Clinical benefit")
plot_boxplot_gene_CB <- function(gene_name, data, colors, labels_display, output_dir) {
  
  df <- data %>%
    filter(gene_clean == gene_name) %>%
    mutate(cb_group = droplevels(factor(cb_group, levels = c("No clinical benefit", "Clinical benefit"))))
  
  wt      <- wilcox.test(expression ~ cb_group, data = df, exact = FALSE)
  p_label <- ifelse(wt$p.value < 0.05,
                    paste0("p = ", formatC(wt$p.value, format = "f", digits = 3), " *"),
                    paste0("p = ", formatC(wt$p.value, format = "f", digits = 3)))
  
  y_max   <- max(df$expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min   <- min(df$expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  y_annot <- y_max + y_range * 0.12
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = cb_group, y = expression, fill = cb_group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75, width = 0.45,
                 color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = cb_group), width = 0.12, size = 2.2,
                alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE) +
    annotate("segment",
             x = 1, xend = 2,
             y = y_annot, yend = y_annot,
             color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5) +
    annotate("text",
             x = 1.5, y = y_annot + y_range * 0.05,
             label = p_label, size = 3.8, color = "grey20") +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels  = labels_display) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min - y_range * 0.05,
                             y_annot + y_range * 0.15)) +
    labs(title = gene_name, x = NULL, y = "log2 Expression") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey20"),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 10)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("Boxplot_CB_", gene_name, ".png")),
    plot     = p, width = 3.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(p)
}
plots_list_CB <- lapply(genes_of_interest, plot_boxplot_gene_CB,
                        data           = db_boxplot_CB,
                        colors         = group_colors_CB,
                        labels_display = group_labels_CB,
                        output_dir     = output_dir)
names(plots_list_CB) <- genes_of_interest
panel_CB <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots_list_CB, ncol = 2, nrow = 2, align = "hv")
panel_title_CB <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
  cowplot::draw_label("Clinical Benefit vs No Clinical Benefit",
                      fontface = "bold", size = 13, x = 0.5, hjust = 0.5)
panel_final_CB <- cowplot::plot_grid(panel_title_CB, panel_CB,
                                     ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.06, 1))
print(panel_final_CB)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "Boxplots_CB_4genes_panel.png"),
  plot     = panel_final_CB, width = 8, height = 9, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r boxplots_DEGs_pSTAT3hs_clinicalbenefit}
library(cowplot)
genes_of_interest <- c("WNT10A", "IL24", "PRKX", "TWIST2")
db_boxplot_pS_CB <- db_completa_log2 %>%
  filter(clinical_benefit == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    ps_group = cut(
      haven::zap_labels(pSTAT3_Histoscore),
      breaks = c(-Inf, 29, 73, Inf),
      labels = c("pSTAT3 low", "pSTAT3 int", "pSTAT3 high"),
      right  = TRUE
    ),
    ps_group = factor(ps_group, levels = c("pSTAT3 low", "pSTAT3 int", "pSTAT3 high"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ps_group)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Codi_Noray, ps_group, starts_with("Endogenous_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("Endogenous_"),
    names_to  = "gene_raw",
    values_to = "expression"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gene_clean = gene_raw %>%
      str_extract("(?<=Endogenous_).*") %>%
      str_remove("_[NX][MR]_\\d+\\.?\\d*$"),
    ps_group   = factor(ps_group, levels = c("pSTAT3 low", "pSTAT3 int", "pSTAT3 high"))
  ) %>%
  filter(gene_clean %in% genes_of_interest)
group_colors_pS <- c("pSTAT3 low"          = "cornflowerblue",
                     "pSTAT3 int" = "goldenrod",
                     "pSTAT3 high"         = "maroon")
group_labels_pS <- c("pSTAT3 low"          = "pSTAT3 low",
                     "pSTAT3 int" = "pSTAT3 int",
                     "pSTAT3 high"         = "pSTAT3 high")
plot_boxplot_gene_pS <- function(gene_name, data, colors, labels_display, output_dir, file_prefix) {
  
  df <- data %>%
    filter(gene_clean == gene_name) %>%
    mutate(ps_group = droplevels(factor(ps_group, levels = c("pSTAT3 low", "pSTAT3 int", "pSTAT3 high"))))
  
  kw      <- kruskal.test(expression ~ ps_group, data = df)
  p_label <- ifelse(kw$p.value < 0.05,
                    paste0("p = ", formatC(kw$p.value, format = "f", digits = 3), " *"),
                    paste0("p = ", formatC(kw$p.value, format = "f", digits = 3)))
  
  y_max   <- max(df$expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_min   <- min(df$expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_range <- y_max - y_min
  y_annot <- y_max + y_range * 0.12
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = ps_group, y = expression, fill = ps_group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75, width = 0.45,
                 color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = ps_group), width = 0.12, size = 2.2,
                alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE) +
    annotate("text",
             x = 2, y = y_annot + y_range * 0.05,
             label = p_label, size = 3.8, color = "grey20") +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels  = labels_display) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min - y_range * 0.05,
                             y_annot + y_range * 0.15)) +
    labs(title = gene_name, x = NULL, y = "log2 Expression") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 13),
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey20", angle = 20, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 10)
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(file_prefix, gene_name, ".png")),
    plot     = p, width = 3.5, height = 4.5, dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(p)
}
plots_list_pS_CB <- lapply(genes_of_interest, plot_boxplot_gene_pS,
                           data           = db_boxplot_pS_CB,
                           colors         = group_colors_pS,
                           labels_display = group_labels_pS,
                           output_dir     = output_dir,
                           file_prefix    = "Boxplot_pSTAT3_CB_")
names(plots_list_pS_CB) <- genes_of_interest
panel_pS_CB <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plots_list_pS_CB, ncol = 2, nrow = 2, align = "hv")
panel_title_pS_CB <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
  cowplot::draw_label("Expression by pSTAT3 group — Clinical benefit",
                      fontface = "bold", size = 13, x = 0.5, hjust = 0.5)
panel_final_pS_CB <- cowplot::plot_grid(panel_title_pS_CB, panel_pS_CB,
                                        ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.06, 1))
print(panel_final_pS_CB)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "Boxplots_pSTAT3_CB_4genes_panel.png"),
  plot     = panel_final_pS_CB, width = 8, height = 9, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r taula_estadistica_boxplots}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Reaprofitem els dos data frames ja en format long generats abans:
# db_boxplot_pS_CB  (clinical_benefit == 1)
# db_boxplot_pS_NCB (clinical_benefit == 0)
# Cal haver executat els dos chunks anteriors.

db_long_pS <- bind_rows(
  db_boxplot_pS_CB  %>% mutate(cohort = "Clinical benefit"),
  db_boxplot_pS_NCB %>% mutate(cohort = "No clinical benefit")
)

# --- Estadístics descriptius per gen × grup pSTAT3 × cohort ---
resum_desc <- db_long_pS %>%
  group_by(gene_clean, ps_group, cohort) %>%
  summarise(
    n      = sum(!is.na(expression)),
    mean   = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd     = sd(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR    = IQR(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Taula ampla: una fila per gen × grup, columnes per cohort
resum_wide <- resum_desc %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = cohort,
    values_from = c(n, mean, median, sd, IQR),
    names_sep   = "_"
  )

# --- Test CB vs NCB per a cada gen × grup pSTAT3 ---
test_cb_ncb <- db_long_pS %>%
  group_by(gene_clean, ps_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_CB  = sum(cohort == "Clinical benefit"    & !is.na(expression)),
    n_NCB = sum(cohort == "No clinical benefit" & !is.na(expression)),
    p_value = if (length(unique(cohort[!is.na(expression)])) == 2 &&
                  n_CB >= 1 && n_NCB >= 1 && (n_CB + n_NCB) >= 3) {
      tryCatch(
        wilcox.test(expression ~ cohort, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    signif = case_when(
      is.na(p_value)    ~ "",
      p_value < 0.001   ~ "***",
      p_value < 0.01    ~ "**",
      p_value < 0.05    ~ "*",
      TRUE              ~ "ns"
    )
  )

# --- Taula final combinada ---
tabla_final <- resum_wide %>%
  left_join(test_cb_ncb, by = c("gene_clean", "ps_group")) %>%
  arrange(gene_clean, ps_group)

print(tabla_final, n = Inf, width = Inf)

write.csv(
  tabla_final,
  file.path(output_dir, "Tabla_pSTAT3_CB_vs_NCB.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```


```{r print_taula}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)

# Requereix haver executat els chunks anteriors (db_long_pS).
# Si no:
# db_long_pS <- bind_rows(
#   db_boxplot_pS_CB  %>% mutate(cohort = "Beneficio clínico"),
#   db_boxplot_pS_NCB %>% mutate(cohort = "No beneficio clínico")
# )

# Recalculem db_long_pS amb etiquetes en castellà
db_long_pS <- bind_rows(
  db_boxplot_pS_CB  %>% mutate(cohort = "Beneficio clínico"),
  db_boxplot_pS_NCB %>% mutate(cohort = "No beneficio clínico")
)

# Traducció dels grups de pSTAT3
trad_ps <- c("pSTAT3 low"          = "pSTAT3 bajo",
             "pSTAT3 intermediate" = "pSTAT3 intermedio",
             "pSTAT3 high"         = "pSTAT3 alto")

resum_desc <- db_long_pS %>%
  group_by(gene_clean, ps_group, cohort) %>%
  summarise(
    n      = sum(!is.na(expression)),
    median = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd     = sd(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

resum_wide <- resum_desc %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = cohort,
    values_from = c(n, median, sd),
    names_sep   = "__"
  )

test_cb_ncb <- db_long_pS %>%
  group_by(gene_clean, ps_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_CB  = sum(cohort == "Beneficio clínico"    & !is.na(expression)),
    n_NCB = sum(cohort == "No beneficio clínico" & !is.na(expression)),
    p_value = if (length(unique(cohort[!is.na(expression)])) == 2 &&
                  n_CB >= 1 && n_NCB >= 1 && (n_CB + n_NCB) >= 3) {
      tryCatch(
        wilcox.test(expression ~ cohort, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_clean, ps_group, p_value)

tabla_final <- resum_wide %>%
  left_join(test_cb_ncb, by = c("gene_clean", "ps_group")) %>%
  arrange(ps_group, gene_clean) %>%
  mutate(ps_group = recode(as.character(ps_group), !!!trad_ps)) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    gene_clean, ps_group,
    `n__Beneficio clínico`, `median__Beneficio clínico`, `sd__Beneficio clínico`,
    `n__No beneficio clínico`, `median__No beneficio clínico`, `sd__No beneficio clínico`,
    p_value
  )

gt_tabla <- tabla_final %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Expresión génica por grupo de pSTAT3: beneficio clínico vs no beneficio clínico**"),
    subtitle = md("*Mediana y desviación estándar (log2). Test de Mann-Whitney entre cohortes.*")
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    gene_clean = "Gen",
    ps_group   = "Grupo pSTAT3",
    `n__Beneficio clínico`      = "n",
    `median__Beneficio clínico` = "Mediana",
    `sd__Beneficio clínico`     = "DE",
    `n__No beneficio clínico`      = "n",
    `median__No beneficio clínico` = "Mediana",
    `sd__No beneficio clínico`     = "DE",
    p_value = "valor p"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label   = md("**Beneficio clínico**"),
    columns = c(`n__Beneficio clínico`, `median__Beneficio clínico`, `sd__Beneficio clínico`)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label   = md("**No beneficio clínico**"),
    columns = c(`n__No beneficio clínico`, `median__No beneficio clínico`, `sd__No beneficio clínico`)
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns  = c(`median__Beneficio clínico`, `sd__Beneficio clínico`,
                 `median__No beneficio clínico`, `sd__No beneficio clínico`),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = p_value, decimals = 3) %>%
  sub_missing(missing_text = "—") %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = p_value,
      rows    = !is.na(p_value) & p_value < 0.05
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size            = px(12),
    heading.title.font.size    = px(15),
    heading.subtitle.font.size = px(12),
    column_labels.font.weight  = "bold"
  )

gtsave(
  gt_tabla,
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "Tabla_pSTAT3_CB_vs_NCB.png"),
  vwidth = 950, vheight = 700
)
```
